_doc: Declared subgroup strand for hospitalization for heart failure among participants without baseline heart failure. The committed cache does not expose a complete trial-level HR+CI set for this subgroup, so no subgroup pool is computed.
why_topic_is_suppressed: The served primary is an overall CVOT HHF pool across mixed populations with and without baseline heart failure. A no-baseline-HF subgroup strand is declared but not computed because the full source-backed trial-level input set is not present in committed cache.

strands.name: Hospitalization for heart failure in participants without baseline heart failure
strands.reason: Committed cache exposes the overall HHF HRs, but not a complete source-backed HR+CI set for the no-baseline-HF subgroup across the served trials.
